sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by XL.
Ability Power scales with the number of Wind elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 4XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Wind elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of L (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
